title: QCDIAG: introducing logcode xml dictionary
description:
Using an xml based dictionary for the thousands of Qualcomm logcodes is more practical.

Having a dictionary makes it more flexible, easier to maintain, source code does not have to be modified when adding/modifying/removing a logcode and end user can easily do some changes locally as well.

The protocol dissector has been also updated to use this newly introduced dictionary.

The implementation has a delay registration of Qualcomm fields to make sure the loading of the dictionary does no impact the application start.

Log code sources:
- [osmo-qcdiag](https://cgit.osmocom.org/osmo-qcdiag)
- [scat](https://github.com/fgsect/scat)
- [leeco](https://github.com/bcyj/android_tools_leeco_msm8996)
- [qlogsort](https://github.com/crs-chin/qlogsort)
- [woodstone10](https://github.com/woodstone10/qualcomm_automation_script_log_filter_and_merge-perl)
- [codelinaro](https://git.codelinaro.org/clo/la/platform/vendor/qcom-opensource/wlan/qcacld-2.0)


Example to test: [qcdiag.pcapng](/uploads/76bb42906f1e5d5b27516e93e630228c/qcdiag.pcapng), [qcdiag_log.pcapng](/uploads/5156811f948418e9d64a407246d4fef5/qcdiag_log.pcapng)

Additional participants: @laf0rge, @osmith42, @lynxis, @martin.r.mathieson
